#   ConfigServer Blocklists › Privacy › General
#   
#   This blocklist is sourced from ConfigServer and contains IP addresses
#   linked to internet intelligence platforms, attack surface scanners,
#   security research organizations, and large-scale network auditing
#   services.
#   
#   These providers continuously scan publicly accessible infrastructure
#   to identify open ports, exposed services, software banners, and other
#   externally reachable assets. Their data is commonly used for internet
#   mapping, vulnerability research, threat intelligence, attack surface
#   monitoring, and search engine indexing of internet-connected systems.
#   
#   The list includes known scanners, crawlers, research networks, and
#   reconnaissance platforms operated by organizations such as:
#   
#       - internet-albedo.net
#       - internet-measurement.com
#       - internet-census.org
#       - Shadowserver Foundation
#       - cyberresilience.io
#       - shodan.io
#       - criminalip.com
#       - recyber.net
#       - openportstats.com
#       - onyphe.io
#       - project25499.com
#       - Censys
#       - CariNet, Inc.
#       - SecurityTrails, LLC
#   
#   These systems are not necessarily malicious; however, they routinely
#   perform automated probing and enumeration against public-facing hosts.
